name: milo-lang
description: Language support for Milo — syntax highlighting, diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, format on save

commands.title: Milo: Run Current File with Arguments

program.description: Path to a .milo source file (compiled with `-g --debug` before launch) or to an already-built executable.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the program.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the directory containing the source file.

stopOnEntry.description: Break at the program's entry point.

runInTerminal.description: Run the program in VS Code's integrated terminal instead of the Debug Console (needed for programs that read stdin).

configurationSnippets.label: Milo: Debug the active file
configurationSnippets.description: Build the active .milo file with -g --debug and launch it under lldb-dap

milo.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `milo` executable. Leave empty to search `~/.local/bin`, `~/.milo/bin`, Homebrew, `/usr/local/bin`, then `PATH`.

milo.compilerRoot.markdownDescription: Dev-only fallback: absolute path to a Milo compiler checkout (the dir containing `src/main.ts`), run via `bun`. Only consulted when no `milo` executable is found — set `milo.path` instead unless you're working on the compiler itself.

milo.lldbDapPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to `lldb-dap` (the debug adapter). Leave empty to search Homebrew LLVM, the Xcode Command Line Tools, `PATH`, `/usr/lib/llvm-*/bin`, then `xcrun`.

milo.debug.markdownDescription: Verbose LSP tracing (sets `MILO_LSP_DEBUG=1`). Logs each request's params and why hover/definition returned empty. Run `Milo: Restart Language Server` after changing.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: bun run typecheck && bun run build
